sources.entry: Solidus - Ecommerce platform that gives you complete control over your store. (Source Code) BSD-3-Clause Ruby/Docker

summary.one_liner: Solidus is a free, open-source e-commerce platform built on Ruby on Rails as a fork of Spree, giving store owners full control over their shop.
summary.what_it_does: Solidus is a Rails-based e-commerce solution distributed as several gems: solidus_core (models, mailers, core classes), solidus_api (RESTful API), solidus_backend (admin area), and solidus_sample (sample data). Requiring the solidus gem installs all of them, or you can use solidus_core alone with your own frontend, admin, and API. The installer generator runs migrations and loads seed and sample data by default, with flags to skip them. The README also covers a Docker-based development setup, a sandbox Rails app for testing, and RSpec test suites run against SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL/MariaDB. Extensions are listed separately at extensions.solidus.io.
use_cases: Running an online store with a Ruby on Rails backend
Building a custom storefront on top of core e-commerce models
Managing products, orders and an admin area for a shop
Exposing store data through a RESTful API
Developing or testing e-commerce extensions for Rails
Prototyping a store with sample data
notable: Modular gem structure: core, API, admin backend, and sample data can be used together or separately
Forked from Spree, with a community-driven project governance led by Nebulab as main contributor
Ships a sandbox Rails app generator for trying the platform locally
Supports PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, and SQLite for both app and test suites
Docker-based development environment with configurable Ruby and Rails versions
caveats: The master branch is not guaranteed to be fully functional and is too risky for production use
Development mode can run slowly unless asset debug is disabled
Turbolinks integration in the admin can break extensions or customizations
Running only the Rails server without bin/dev can cause missing asset errors such as solidus_admin/tailwind.css
